title: codonoboea holttumii

It is native to Southeast Asia and is traditionally used in folk medicine. The therapeutic actions of Codonoboea holttumii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
